title: Three Hidden Consequences of the K-Field

consequences.name: Geometric Origin of Physical Constants
consequences.summary: Dimensionless physical constants become geometric invariants instead of independent parameters.
consequences.premise: The K-Field is the underlying geometric substrate.
implications: Proton-to-electron mass ratio derives from Cell3 geometry.
Fine-structure-related carrier scale derives from Cell3 face-area relations.
Apparently independent constants become projections of one geometric object.

consequences.name: Unified Geometric Description of Physical Interactions
consequences.summary: Gravity, inertia, and electromagnetism become different observer renderings of one geometric framework.
consequences.premise: Direct geometry defines structure while reciprocal geometry defines interaction.
implications: Multiple interactions arise from one substrate.
Holonomy and registry state determine observed behavior.

consequences.name: Global Geometric Reference Frame
consequences.summary: The universe possesses a fixed geometric orientation rather than complete rotational equivalence.
consequences.premise: The K-Field is locked to the ICRS/J2000.0 reference frame.
implications: Every physical system has a measurable orientation relative to the K-Field.
Directional anisotropy is a natural consequence.
Laboratory and astronomical observations share one geometric reference.
